gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.

gaps.explanation: bring up a child = raise, educate them.

gaps.sentence: The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.

gaps.sentence: She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.

gaps.explanation: look a word up = find it in a dictionary/reference.

gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
